The '''CEC Class-1 escape pod''' was a model of [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] with capacity for a single passenger that was manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] acquired the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carried five Class-1 escape pods.
